The '''Tinnel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Quanta sector/Legends|Quanta sector]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] that contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tinnel IV/Legends|Tinnel IV]].
